gloss: to carry forward; to carry over

definitions.gloss: to carry forward; to carry over (a balance, an item)
definitions.explanation: To move an amount, budget or item that was not used or finished into the next period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}す。
⟦{余|あま}った→余る：00001_amaru⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{翌年度|よくねんど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}した。
examples.english: We carried the leftover budget over to the next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}わなかった→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{翌年|よくとし}→翌年：03184_yokutoshi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Paid leave you don't use can be carried over to the next year.

notes:
⟦{繰|く}る→繰る：30725_kuru⟧ (to reel, turn over) + ⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧ (to go past).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}す (carry X over to Y)

FORMS:
- {繰|く}り{越|こ}し: carrying over; {繰越金|くりこしきん}: balance carried forward

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}す: to carry a balance forward
- ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}す: to carry over to the next month
- ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}→有給：04552_yuukyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{越|こ}す: to carry over paid leave
